intent_summary: Implement local-only Pi Session Continuity v0.1.2 hardening.
Replace turn_end automatic triggering with a context-hook safe-boundary guard that fires only after complete tool-result batches before the next provider request.
Keep native Pi auto-compaction unsupported/not recommended for reliable automatic handoffs and warn strongly instead of arbitrating.
Add duplicate-load singleton guard, top-level /continuity menu, warning throttling, and clearer end-to-end documentation.

lane.architecture_note: Focused hardening within existing extension architecture and product spec. Repository has historical specforge/runs authority but no docs/specforge/architecture-context-v0.yaml; absence is recorded as a Flow advisory and not treated as permission to publish or mutate external state.

planned_validation.purpose: unit coverage for trigger, singleton, menu, warnings, and invariant behavior
local package contents check without publishing

plan.writer: spawned implement worker via pi-subagents worker
notes: Product spec must be updated before behavior code.
Keep implementation local-only and do not publish/install.
Manual checkpoint behavior remains a full Continuity Handoff and should bypass only automatic trigger timing changes.

known_answer_cases.description: Automatic trigger no longer registers on turn_end and instead evaluates safe context boundaries.
A complete assistant/tool-result batch is required before automatic mid-run handoff can start.
Bare /continuity opens a top-level menu with checkpoint, while /continuity settings opens settings directly.
README/product spec explain save artifact -> compact preserving recent raw tokens -> resume from disk artifact.

negative_or_error_cases.description: Incomplete tool-result batches do not trigger automatic handoff.
Duplicate extension load does not register duplicate handlers or commands.
Repeated usage-unavailable automatic checks do not spam warnings.
Native Pi auto-compaction enabled emits a strong unsupported/not-recommended warning but no arbitration path.

required_evidence.description: Automated test suite covers changed behavior and still passes.
Product spec and public docs match the implemented v0.1.2 contract and local-only constraints.

claims.claim: Product contract and public docs describe v0.1.2 local safe-boundary behavior, native auto-compaction warning/no-arbitration policy, top-level /continuity menu, and end-to-end save -> compact-with-recent-tokens -> disk-resume flow.
Automatic PSC handoff no longer uses turn_end; it evaluates in the context hook only after a complete assistant/tool-result batch before the next provider request.
The duplicate-load singleton guard is scoped to runtime/load-group identity and releases on session_shutdown, preventing duplicate same-runtime registration without suppressing independent runtimes.
/continuity opens a top-level menu with Status, Create checkpoint now, Settings, Done while /continuity settings remains a direct settings shortcut.
Local validation passed after the final diff: npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm pack --dry-run.
No npm publish, GitHub push/tag, .claude publication/install, global Pi settings mutation, or Pi package install was performed.

non_claims: No npm package was published and npm latest remains outside this local run.
No GitHub commit, push, release, or tag was created by this run.
No .claude publication/install or global Pi settings mutation was performed.
No complex session_before_compact arbitration/coexistence with native Pi auto-compaction was added.
No guarantee is claimed for automatic handoff in no-tool prompt/response sessions under v0.1.2 safe-boundary triggering.
